text:
morgan: quick check — PR #8248 touches `runtime/kv-cache` and `infra/k8s/helm/models-deploy`. who has final sign-off here?
lee: hmm both dirs have CODEOWNERS. runtime is owned by @carol, infra by @eng-platform (team).
carol: I can review the runtime bits, but I didn't touch Helm in months. can someone from infra take the k8s/helm change? :eyes:
ina: pinging @ina from eng-platform — is the helm change low-risk? CI shows only a small values change.
ina: (added) the change is a default replica bump and a new env var for model-quant. safe, but we should verify chart values schema.
ina: also FYI CODEOWNERS has a glob for infra: `infra/k8s/** @eng-platform` and runtime pattern `runtime/** @carol`
morgan: thanks. two approval paths then. is there an acceptable handoff pattern here? do we need explicit cross-approval or can infra approve and runtime ACK in comments?
lee: per our CODEOWNERS process, if a PR touches multiple owners you need at least one approval from each owner group listed in CODEOWNERS unless an owner explicitly delegates in-thread.
carol: I can delegate runtime sign-off to @lee for this tiny change (only a small kv default). lee: I can take runtime approval if carol drops a quick comment `runtime-approval: delegated to lee` so audit trail shows who accepted.
morgan: can we paste the delegation as a short note, then infra can approve and we merge? CI passing required of course.
carol: runtime-approval: delegated to lee — I'll add that as a comment on the PR now. :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: build/8248 — all checks passed (unit, lint).
ina: infra review done, left one nits comment on chart notes. approved from my side once nits addressed. :thumbsup:
lee: runtime quick test locally — kv default delta looks fine. approving now.
morgan: thanks all — I'll wait for nits to be addressed and then merge. small note: if anyone hits an owner rotation edge-case, we have the `codeowners-override` label flow (requires two eng-platform approvers + EngPlatform manager signoff).
carol: re: owner rotation — filing a brief follow-up in the PR to remind on the rotation list so we don't lose track.
morgan: merge done after nit fix. tagging for changelog. :tada:
